### Futile Searches
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-oct-10-2008-11582786.html
Passage: Job 10:18-20
Points:
- Overwhelmed by grief and confusion, Job relapses into wishing he had died at birth.
- Theoretical musings and philosophical advice offer no true relief when suffering crushes the spirit.
- Searching for answers without an advocate to plead one's case leaves the sufferer feeling hopeless.
- Believers have what Job lacked: a living, approachable Mediator in Jesus Christ.
- Christ meets our deepest miseries with an even greater supply of divine mercy.
